card.name: Monitoring after drug concentration terms
card.fires_on: The word "monitoring" (or "concentrations") right after "therapeutic drug" or "concentration", mostly for immunosuppressants and similar drugs with blood-level checks.

modes.label: Therapeutic drug monitoring
modes.description: "Monitoring" completes the phrase therapeutic drug/concentration monitoring in immunosuppressant text.
modes.example: Therapeutic drug<< monitoring>> should be used to maintain sirolimus

modes.label: Level monitoring of a named drug
modes.description: "Monitoring" or "concentrations" follows a drug name plus serum or blood concentration.
modes.example: Increase monitoring of digoxin<< concentrations>> and potential signs and symptoms of clinical toxicity

card.writes: It promotes monitoring, feedback and guidance words, including Chinese equivalents, so it adds the idea of monitoring or oversight.
card.plain: It lights up on the word monitoring when the text is about checking a drug's blood levels.
